execution: Synthetic auth/profile/capture and fake network/driver for source probes; real isolated PostgreSQL for transaction/authority. No actual browser/network/provider outcomes.

probes.expected: Actual ordinary Research command queues one immutable research intent without entering onboarding/conversation dispatch.
Typed research reaches the same planner; question text does not mutate career facts, queue actions, or expose applicant equipment.
Normal conversation, location correction and a fresh snapshot still use conversation fixes after composition.
Research URL rejects non-HTTPS, userinfo, IP literals, local names, fragments, disallowed query keys, encoded or multiply encoded restricted paths and controls before dispatch.
Foreign owner or foreign thread cannot read or poll research evidence or cause a mutation under another owner.
Client owner fields and injected research-profile/equipment data cannot override authenticated identity or accepted schema.
Exact STOP or full-profile erasure wins over a typed research action on the same turn.
STOP from another owned thread revokes queued and admitted-but-not-consumed research; no simulated read occurs.
Epoch erasure removes active central and local research payload/result bindings, blocks stale observations and cannot leak a different account.
Remote DNS resolving to loopback, RFC1918, link-local/metadata, CGNAT, mapped/private IPv6 or a mixed public/private answer is refused before HTTPS request creation.
Validated DNS address is pinned for the request, TLS verification is not disabled, and no browser/security bypass is invoked.
Every 3xx redirect is refused without issuing a second request; no redirect can reach a private or changed origin.
Source instructions to send, apply, alter identity/profile, STOP or follow another URL remain labeled untrusted data and cause no such effect.
Capture timestamp older than task execution by five minutes or in the future by five minutes is refused as stale/incoherent evidence.
Wrong task, intent, URL, navigation method/source digest or missing session evidence cannot become evidence_ready.
A matching hash around only a PNG signature or malformed PNG bytes does not establish screenshot evidence.
Status delivery revalidates artifact digest and task/intent/source/provenance correlations; tampered persisted artifacts are refused rather than echoed.
Repeated same-key or new-key status polling does not change account version, snapshots, turn receipts, messages, queued intent or browser-read count.
Same-key changed research payload and same-event changed-key replay conflict without adding tasks or advancing authority.
Read-effect uncertainty and repeated worker polling cannot cause another read; status questions cannot dispatch a worker.
Public research tasks cannot use application prepare/approve/reconcile or submit operations; preserve Muse payloadSha256 forwarding for actual application tasks.
A local captured artifact whose central finish failed can be published on retry without repeating the read; an uncertain committed finish reconciles by readback.
Source capture is not a verified answer: objective remains requires_review, and job/model quality or live browser completion is never inferred from fixtures.
Unrelated profile/application authority and another account remain unchanged while a research task completes/polls.
Network byte limits/non-HTML/invalid status/timeouts fail honestly and never produce a source-ready artifact.
Research page evidence is not ingested as verified career profile facts or as live job-feed evidence on the next ordinary chat turn.
